caption: The drawing depicts a square positioned diagonally so that it appears as a diamond. Inside the diamond, two red flowers with yellow centers and visible red outline details are situated, one on the left and one on the right. Both flowers are attached to green stems and are accompanied by green leaves with jagged edges, all branching out from a central point toward the bottom of the diamond. The background within the diamond is shaded with light blue wavy lines while the area outside the diamond remains plain. The drawing is on off-white or slightly yellowed paper, and there is handwriting and some red text visible near the bottom edge.
title: Quilt Pattern
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
